dump_mfcc_features_from_audio: run the script to dump MFCC features from audio files in a TSV directory to a feature directory
read_audio_with_MfccFeatureReader: create an MfccFeatureReader instance to read audio waveform data from a file path with optional reference length validation
extract_mfcc_features: use MfccFeatureReader get_feats to extract MFCC features with deltas and double deltas from an audio file
iterate_audio_paths: use get_path_iterator to shard and iterate over audio file paths from a TSV split file
dump_extracted_features: use dump_feature to save extracted audio features to disk with shard and rank support
